name: ToggleSwitch
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play iOS-style animated toggle switch — built on top of Unity's OWN Toggle component rather than reimplementing click/keyboard/gamepad-navigation handling from scratch, so all of that keeps working exactly as it does on any other Toggle. This just adds the sliding-handle + background-color visual on top, since Unity's stock Toggle only ships with a plain checkbox look.

src_serialized.name: handle
src_serialized.tooltip: The knob that slides between the off/on positions. Auto-found among children if left empty.

src_serialized.name: background
src_serialized.tooltip: The track behind the handle, tinted per state. Auto-found on this GameObject if left empty.

src_serialized.name: handleOffX
src_serialized.tooltip: The handle's local X position when off vs on, in UI units.
